components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for running workflows, saving graphs, and submitting forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; background: var(--accent-primary, #10b981); color: #09090b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #34d399; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid #10b981; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default elevated button for secondary actions and toolbar controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #27272a); background: var(--bg-elevated, #18181c); color: var(--text-primary, #fafafa); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #3f3f46); background: #27272a; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact status pill for queue depth, model tier, and execution state.
components.css: .ds-badge-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: #6ee7b7; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact obsidian input field for inspector forms and search bars.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #27272a); background: var(--bg-canvas, #09090b); color: var(--text-primary, #fafafa); padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #71717a); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #3f3f46); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-primary, #10b981); }

components.name: Workflow Node Card
components.description: Elevated node card rendered on the React Flow DAG canvas.
components.css: .ds-node-card { width: 220px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #27272a); background: var(--bg-elevated, #18181c); padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--text-primary, #fafafa); } .ds-node-meta { font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted, #71717a); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-node-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Sosho Studio operates as a desktop-first local developer workbench where scanability, speed, and consistency outrank visual ornament. The interface uses a restrained obsidian palette with three distinct neutral surface layers so dense workflow graphs, model streams, memory records, and audio controls remain clear during long sessions.

Familiar developer patterns from code editors and node orchestrators anchor every screen. Primary controls stay visible while secondary engine parameters tuck inside collapsed accordions. Motion is brief and strictly communicates state changes, active execution, or focus.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal neutral hierarchy: Obsidian canvas, surface rail, and elevated card layers separate work zones without heavy shadows.
Semantic state discipline: Emerald, sky, amber, and red accents appear only on primary actions, active selections, and live status indicators.
Progressive disclosure: Three primary controls lead each inspector or form, with advanced parameters collapsed by default.

rules.name: The State-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Never apply accent-primary, state-info, state-warning, or state-error as static background decoration; reserve them for interactive actions and live status.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Use fixed rem sizes rather than fluid clamp() headings so sidebars and inspectors maintain uniform density across desktop monitors.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep panels, cards, and nodes flat at rest; express hierarchy through surface step and border contrast.

dos: Do use skeleton placeholders for loading states instead of centered spinners.
Do render overlays, dropdowns, and tooltips in Radix portals so scroll containers never clip them.
Do show three primary controls first and place secondary knobs inside a collapsed Radix Accordion.
donts: Don't open modal dialogs when an inline bar, accordion, or drawer solves the task.
Don't invent custom button shapes or mismatched form controls across screens.
Don't add decorative page-load animations or saturated accents on inactive elements.
